Discover the new jet. Book a private visit this month. Click the link. Don't miss it!
Hi Karina, I read your ad. It is a good start!
Thank you, Mike. It is my first ad in English.
My first tip: start with a verb. Write Discover the new jet, not We have a new jet.
OK. Discover the new jet. It is shorter and stronger.
Exactly. Who are your customers for this jet?
Business people from the Middle East and from Europe.
Then write one clear action for them: Click the link, or Book a visit. Only one.
Good. Book a private visit. And at the end: Don't miss it!
Perfect. Do you have a slogan?
Yes. Fly with confidence. We launch the ad on Monday!

Are you ready to fly? Come to the Sao Paulo Business Aviation Fair, from May tenth to May twelfth. Discover more than forty new aircraft. Meet the best companies in the world. Visit our booth, number twelve, and talk to our team. Please book your ticket online today. Students and new customers have a special price. Don't miss the biggest aviation event of the year. Click the link and see you at the fair!

Hi, I am Sofia, from Texas. Last week I made my first video ad, and I want to share three tips with you. First, make it short. My ad is only thirty seconds. Second, start with a strong verb, like Discover or Imagine. Third, always end with one clear action. My ad ends with: Send us a message today. After one week, twenty new customers sent me a message. So, don't wait. Make your first ad this week!

First, Karina writes her first ad in English. Then, Mike reads the ad and sends her five tips. Next, Karina starts every line with a verb. After that, she adds her slogan: Fly with confidence. Finally, she launches the ad on Monday.
